model_r.c_v_method: derived: median of sigma_min/t_min over all 2880 base-area pairs
model_r.T_method: recommendation, not data: T=30 (Model R default) makes a_jv and b_jv almost all 1 on this instance; see README
model_r.C_j_source: use bases.csv (real capacities 1-3), not the Model R default C_j=2
model_r.q_method: not derivable: the source does not state the period covered by total_calls; must be set as an assumption
model_r.t_jv_note: source gives response time, which may include pre-travel delay; Model R expects driving time
